formula: I/he/she/it + was   |   you/we/they + were   |   Negative: wasn't / weren't
when_to_use: Use was/were to talk about the past: where you were, how you felt, what things were like. Then review every A1 pattern together.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم was/were للكلام عن الماضي: كنت فين، وحسيت بإيه. وبعدين نراجع كل قواعد A1.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Arabic past nominal sentences use كان and agree differently, so was/were get swapped — especially 'they was'. Remember: only you/we/they take WERE.

common_errors.explanation: In questions, 'were' comes before the subject.

quick_rule: I/he/she/it → WAS · you/we/they → WERE. Same split as am/is vs are.
quick_rule_ar: I/he/she/it مع was، و you/we/they مع were. نفس تقسيم am/is و are.
connect_to_speaking: Tell a short past story, then review: 'Yesterday I was at home. My family were with me. I am a student, I have got two brothers, and I can swim.'
